title: VDBE statement profile callback dispatch

scope.rationale: invokeProfileCallback owns the one-shot conversion of a statement start timestamp into elapsed nanoseconds and dispatches both legacy and trace-v2 profile callbacks before consuming the timestamp.

external_source_responsibilities: Source sqlite3OsCurrentTimeInt64 dispatch against the connection VFS
dependencies.caller_closure: The complete callback body is assigned. A named current-time operation retains the exact VFS boundary until source-layout VFS ownership is connected.

inputs: Source-layout Sqlite3 and Vdbe with positive startTime, saved SQL text, idle initialization state, and a current-time operation
outputs: No result code; optional callbacks receive one exact elapsed interval and startTime becomes zero
contracts.ownership: SQL, callback arguments, statement, connection, and stack-local elapsed value are borrowed for callback duration only.
contracts.state_and_results: Elapsed time is the signed current-time millisecond delta multiplied by 1,000,000 nanoseconds. Legacy profile receives the bit-preserving u64 value; trace-v2 receives SQLITE_TRACE_PROFILE, the Vdbe, and a pointer to the signed interval. startTime is consumed after callbacks.
contracts.locks_callbacks_io: Callers own the connection mutex. Current-time VFS dispatch precedes user callbacks; legacy callback precedes trace-v2. The current-time result code is intentionally ignored as in source.
contracts.failure_and_continuation: Callback return values do not alter statement state. After dispatch, repeated checks see startTime zero and do not invoke this body again.

representation_differences: sqlite3OsCurrentTimeInt64 is a named function pointer until the exact source-layout VFS pointer is connected.
The source stack pointer to iElapse is represented by an aligned anyopaque pointer only for the synchronous xV2 callback duration.

oracle.protocol: A native source-layout unit trace supplies timestamps 100 and 130, enables both callback families, and compares exact legacy/v2 elapsed values, trace event, Vdbe identity, and one-shot startTime consumption.
internal_observations: trace event, elapsed value, and Vdbe identity
oracle.normalization: Callback pointer addresses are reduced to Vdbe identity equality; elapsed values and events are exact. A pinned-C trace remains pending.

assurance.io_crash_concurrency: One VFS time read is delegated; no durable I/O. Caller mutex integration remains pending.
assurance.malformed_input: Positive start time, idle init state, and non-null SQL are source assertions rather than recoverable inputs.
assurance.continuation: Timestamp consumption prevents duplicate profile dispatch.
assurance.performance: Constant time plus one clock read and up to two synchronous callbacks.

integration.production_owner: src/core/internal/vdbe_api.zig source-layout statement lifecycle API layer
integration.native_call_path: The exact source-layout operation and native unit trace are implemented; finalize/reset/step and VFS time integration remain pending.
integration.bounded_owner_retired: No. The bounded frontend retains a separate profile callback owner.

independent_review.notes: Requires pinned-C trace, lifecycle/VFS/public-owner integration, assurance closure, and independent review.
